You will benefit from attractive employment conditions including, in particular, opportunities for continuing training and development throughout your professional career with us, as well as social benefits and other attractive benefits. For an optimal balance between professional and private life, we offer our employees different contractual models, including part-time and the FLEXible contract. There is also the possibility of benefiting from up to 7 weeks of vacation thanks to our “Leave-Plus” offer.
